title: Wetland Bird Walk, Bengaluru
shortDescription: A beginner-friendly guided walk to observe and identify wetland birds while learning basic birdwatching and eBird checklist skills.
description: Join experienced birdwatchers for a morning walk around a Bengaluru wetland. Learn how to identify common waterbirds, use binoculars effectively, and record observations responsibly.
The walk is suitable for beginners, students, families, and anyone interested in learning more about urban birdlife.

details.when: Sunday, 20 December 2026. Meet in the morning; final timing will be shared with registered participants.
details.where: A Bengaluru wetland. The exact meeting point will be shared with registered participants.
details.how: Register in advance, wear comfortable walking shoes, and bring binoculars if you have them. A limited number may be available to share.
details.challenges: Wetland paths may be uneven or muddy, and bird activity can vary with weather. Please follow the group leader’s guidance and stay on marked paths.
details.additionalInformation: This beginner-friendly walk is suitable for students and families. Children should be accompanied by an adult; please bring drinking water and avoid feeding or approaching wildlife.
details.tutorials: New to birding? We’ll cover binocular basics, identifying common waterbirds, and recording observations during the walk.

pressRelease.title: Join a beginner-friendly wetland bird walk in Bengaluru
pressRelease.description: The Karnataka Bird Monitoring Network invites birdwatchers, students, families, and nature enthusiasts to a guided morning walk at a Bengaluru wetland. Participants will learn to identify common waterbirds and record observations responsibly.
